findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: design_qr, generate_qr_code, generate_barcode, update_code_destination, search_docs, read_docs_page · Private data: design_qr, generate_qr_code, qr_payload_vcard, qr_payload_mecard · Public sink: design_qr, qr_payload_email, qr_payload_sms, update_code_destination · Destructive: generate_barcode.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: design_qr, generate_qr_code, generate_barcode, update_code_destination, search_docs, read_docs_page · Private data: design_qr, generate_qr_code, qr_payload_vcard, qr_payload_mecard · Public sink: design_qr, qr_payload_email, qr_payload_sms, update_code_destination · Destructive: generate_barcode

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
